title: Task Object Schema (Separated Architecture)
description: Minimal task object with references to external files (tests, workflow, plan)

id.description: Task ID in format P{phase}-{feature}-T{number}, e.g., P2-PROF-T1

content.description: Imperative form: 'Complete JWT utils implementation and testing'

activeForm.description: Present continuous form: 'Completing JWT utils implementation and testing'

description.description: Detailed description of what this task accomplishes

testSuiteRef.description: Reference to test suite file, e.g., 'tests/task-3-tests.json'

planningResultRef.description: Optional reference to planning result file, e.g., 'plans/task-3-plan.json'

dependencies.description: Array of task IDs that must be completed before this task

blockers.description: Array of blocker descriptions preventing task progress
